howToPlay: Barley is an artillery brawler who controls enemy movement by throwing bottles that deal area damage. Use his gadgets and star powers to heal himself or allies, or to slow down enemies to secure control of the map.
gears: Equip DAMAGE and GADGET COOLDOWN to maximize offensive pressure and utility. SHIELD or HEALTH are also effective choices to increase survivability while maintaining field presence.
trait: Barley suits players who prefer strategic area control and support-oriented gameplay over direct combat.
